split.sampling: All test chunks in the v2 split used by the authors' model evaluation code, in manifest order. All input tokens are retained.

scoring.procedure: Zero-shot named entity recognition, followed by relation extraction conditioned on that model's predicted entities.
scoring.author_entity_metric: Token precision, recall and F1 by entity type
scoring.author_relation_metric: Substring tuple matching where reported. This legacy rule can skip empty predictions and reuse matches.
scoring.aggregate: The archive reports F1 for each stage from matched, extra and missed entities or tuples within its reported scoring scope. The board ranks by strict entity span F1 when a complete scope is available.
